name: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Manila Leg 3
short_description: A Runrio-organized race in Pasay, Philippines on September 6, 2026, offering 32km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances.
ai_summary: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Manila Leg 3 is a road race organized by Runrio under the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia brand, scheduled for September 6, 2026, at SM Mall of Asia in Pasay, Philippines. Runners can choose from four distances: 32km, 21.1km (half-marathon, the primary distance), 10km, and 5km. Registration details have not yet been announced.

core_facts.organizer: Runrio (brand: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia)

pros: Multiple distance options (32km, 21.1km, 10km, 5km) to suit different runner levels
Held at the well-known SM Mall of Asia venue in Pasay
Organized by Runrio, an established race organizer, under the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia brand
cons: Registration status is not yet announced, so sign-up details are unavailable
research_highlights: The race is held at SM Mall of Asia / Seaside Boulevard in Pasay City, and Runna classifies the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia course as flat.
Manila Leg 3 2026 offers 5K, 10K, 21K and 32K distances, part of a progressive three-leg format per city that builds up in distance across the year before a National Finals in November.
The series draws large fields in Manila — over 11,600 runners took part in the March 2025 Manila Leg 1, with about 5,000 in the 16K category alone.
The event is organized by Runrio (RUNRIO president Rio de la Cruz) with Santé Barley as title sponsor, and has run multi-year editions (formerly branded HOKA Trilogy Run Asia).
A Pinoy Fitness forum commenter noted that fun-run distances like the 5K typically start very early, around 5am, with about a 1-hour cutoff for that category.
research_watchouts: No independent participant race reports or reviews with course/organization feedback were found for this specific Manila Leg 3 event or its recent predecessors — most available coverage is organizer press releases and results-only news pool stories.
Listings on review aggregator sites (e.g. Let's Do This) show this event currently has no submitted runner reviews.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The race offers four distance options for participants to choose from: 32km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. The primary distance for this event is the 21.1km half-marathon, though runners can select whichever distance best suits their fitness level and goals.

faqs.question: Where is the race venue located?
faqs.answer: The race takes place at SM Mall of Asia, located in Pasay, in the Philippines. This venue serves as the starting point for the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Manila Leg 3 event on the scheduled race date.

faqs.question: Is registration open for this race?
faqs.answer: According to available information, the registration status for this race has not yet been announced. Prospective participants will need to watch for further updates from the organizer, Runrio, regarding when and how registration will open for this event.

faqs.question: Who is organizing this race?
faqs.answer: This race is organized by Runrio, operating under the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia brand. It is the Manila Leg 3 installment of the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 series, scheduled to be held on September 6, 2026, in Pasay.
